title: Quasi-coherent derived categories have direct sums
statement: For every scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], the full subcategory $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ on complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology has all set-indexed direct sums.

proof.text: By [lem-pc-derived-ambient-direct-sums], $D(\mathcal O_X)$ has set-indexed direct sums represented by termwise direct sums of complexes, and their degree-$q$ cohomology sheaf is $\bigoplus_i H^q(E_i)$ for every integer $q$.

source.place: proof of Lemma 08DT (lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-sums), first three sentences, citing Injectives, Lemma 07D9 (lemma-derived-products)

proof.text: Fix a degree $q$ and a family $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. Each $H^q(E_i)$ is quasi-coherent by [def-pc-derived-category]. The finite subsets $J\subseteq I$, ordered by inclusion, form a directed set even when $I$ is empty: $\varnothing$ is a member and $J\cup K$ is an upper bound. Set $F_J=\bigoplus_{i\in J}H^q(E_i)$, with the usual inclusion maps. $F_{\varnothing}=0$ is quasi-coherent from its affine-local definition, and induction on the size of $J$ using [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-direct-sum] makes every $F_J$ quasi-coherent. For any sheaf $G$, compatible maps $F_J\to G$ are exactly families of maps $H^q(E_i)\to G$: restrict to singleton subsets in one direction, and use the finite-sum universal property in the other. Hence the colimit of $(F_J)_J$ in $\mathcal O_X$-modules is $\bigoplus_{i\in I}H^q(E_i)$. It is quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-colimit-affine-sections].

source.place: proof of Lemma 08DT (lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-sums), last sentence; Schemes, Section 01LA (section-quasi-coherent)

proof.text: Step 2 applied to the cohomology identity of Step 1 shows that the ambient sum $E=\bigoplus_i E_i$ has quasi-coherent cohomology in every degree; hence $E$ belongs to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ by [def-pc-derived-category]. For any $G$ in that full subcategory, the ambient coproduct bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(E,G)\cong\prod_i\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(E_i,G)$ from [lem-pc-derived-ambient-direct-sums] is the same bijection in the full subcategory. Thus $E$ is its coproduct, also for the empty and singleton families.
